page.overview:
What is Angels of Redemption?

The Angels of Redemption is a Loyalist Chapter of Space Marines and a Second Founding successor of the Dark Angels Legion. It is thus counted amongst the ranks of the Unforgiven Chapters.

Nothing can dissuade the Angels of Redemption from their mission to hunt down the Fallen Angels, and it has been noted that the Chapter has, on occasion, withdrawn from a campaign in order to pursue its own undisclosed ends.

It was at the height of the Defence of Gaitlinghive in the 41st Millennium that the Angels of Redemption redeployed at the moment of the Orks' final assault, leaving seven brigades of Gaitlinghive militia alone to face an Orkish horde three million Greenskins strong.

The Angels of Redemption were never called to account for this act, as there were no survivors to press any formal inquiry. The Angels themselves embarked upon a hunt that led them to capture the Fallen Dark Angel Baalakai -- a victory, to them, worth the lives of the Gaitlinghive militia, and the population of the hive city they fought to protect.
